custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Vendor Order Management — View only: no Vendor Order Management — Create & Edit, no Part Library & Inventory box, no Part Sales — Create & Edit, no work order permission to pick parts, no Settings permission and no See Financial Data, so no setting gives user B part search access.
    • How to do it: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu, then Create Custom Role; in Choose a template click Skip; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573686 ROLE B in Role Name*; switch on Parts Department and tick only View on the Vendor and order management row; then click Create. Leave See Financial Data (under Cross-Cutting Toggles) off.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
    • How to do it: User B is the shared Tech sign-in given role B: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, Staff in the left menu, click Search, type tech@shopview.com, click the edit icon at the end of Tech ShopView's row, pick ZZAUTOTEST PL C573686 ROLE B under Role and click Save & Close. In the private window choose Tech on the sign-in screen. When the test is finished set Tech ShopView's Role back to Technician the same way.
  • Use a second browser window (a private window) signed in as user B.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A, and an active part, part A, with vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573686 VENDOR A in Name *, then click Save & Close. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573686 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573686-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, pick vendor A under Vendor, type 1 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Write down the address of the Create Return page: as the Admin, open Parts, then Returns, click Create Return, and copy the address from the browser's address bar.
